title: Thai Green Curry
subtitle: Fragrant coconut curry with chicken and Thai basil
excerpt: Chicken thighs simmered in a fragrant green curry paste with coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime leaves until rich and deeply flavoured. Served over jasmine rice.

recipe.sourceNotes: Thai green curry (gaeng kiaw wan) is one of the most internationally well-known Thai dishes. The green colour comes from green chillies, which are ground with lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime zest, garlic, shallots, coriander root, and shrimp paste to make the curry paste. Good shop-bought green curry paste (Maeploy or Aroy-D are widely considered the best available brands) is an acceptable substitute for home-made paste and produces an authentic result. The dish is from central Thailand and is sweeter and creamier than the sour and spicy dishes of the north.

recipeTools.notes: Wide pan or wok for the curry.

content.text: Fry the curry paste in the thick coconut cream (skimmed from the top of an unshaken tin) until fragrant before adding anything else: this blooms the spices and removes the raw edge. Do not substitute reduced-fat coconut milk: the fat is what carries the flavour. The curry should not boil once the coconut milk is added; a gentle simmer keeps it creamy rather than greasy.

items.preparation: boneless, skinless, cut into large pieces
white part only, finely chopped (or 4 tbsp shop-bought green curry paste)
Thai basil or regular basil, to serve

content.text: If making your own paste: blend the lemongrass, chilli, shallots, galangal, garlic, coriander, and cumin with 2 tablespoons of water until smooth. Open the coconut milk tins without shaking. Scoop the thick cream from the top into a wide pan over medium heat. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling. Add the paste and fry, stirring constantly, for 3 to 4 minutes until very fragrant.
Add the chicken pieces and stir to coat in the paste. Cook for 3 minutes. Pour in the remaining coconut milk. Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar. Bring to a gentle simmer.

Simmer for 10 minutes. Add the courgette and green beans. Cook for a further 5 to 7 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender. Taste and balance: add more fish sauce for salt, lime juice for sourness, or sugar for sweetness.
Scatter with basil and sliced chilli. Serve over jasmine rice.
